ModMetaData.name: Recoverable Throwables 1.5 v1.4
ModMetaData.author: Allen / ChatGPT
ModMetaData.description: Physical thrown weapons such as javelins, throwing axes and throwing knives become finite, recoverable equipment. V1.4 resolves the actual Verse.Projectile.Launch overload from the runtime assembly instead of hard-coding a signature, fixing Harmony startup failure on RimWorld 1.5.4063. One real weapon is removed per launched projectile and restored when that projectile ends. Explosive grenade-style throwables remain the responsibility of Grenade One-Use.
